::: {.letter-metadata}
**Date:** Sept 17 [1889?]  
**From:** Elderfield  
**Manuscript:** MS UCLA: collection 100: box 95
:::

My dear [Bella](people/person_1690.qmd)

I think the day had better be Friday, as [Gertrude](people/person_1462.qmd) has been rather out of order these last few days, but is picking up again. It will be a great day of church decoration, but I shall be sure to have done by 4 o’clock, and I shall be very glad to see you and [Miss Fawcett](people/person_2395.qmd).[^1]

Yours affectionately
C M Yonge

---

[^1]: The feast day of St Matthew, patron of Otterbourne Church, is 21 September, which fell on a Saturday in 1889.
